# VINASIG Design System

> A draft, AI-readable source of shared UI guidance for VINASIG websites. All rules are proposals pending approval.

Start with the repository's `AGENTS.md` for agent instructions and project context. Read the source specification linked for the task. Do not assume draft rules are approved policy.

## Published guides

- [Overview](/) explains the purpose and current status.
- [Brand and logo](/brand/) describes logo variants, asset downloads, and draft usage recommendations.
- [Foundations](/foundations/) covers color, typography, spacing, responsive behavior, accessibility, and writing style.
- [Components](/components/) describes buttons, text inputs, status messages, and cards.
- [Patterns](/patterns/) covers forms, empty states, loading, errors, and page layout.
- [AI agent guide](/agents/) explains how an agent should use this system.

## Source files

- `AGENTS.md` describes project context and working rules.
- `docs/foundations/README.md` specifies the foundations.
- `docs/brand/README.md` records logo source facts, file mapping, and draft usage guidance.
- `docs/components/README.md` specifies common interface components.
- `docs/patterns/README.md` specifies reusable page patterns.
- `src/styles/tokens.css` contains the implemented CSS design tokens.
